name: timer-ring
title: Timer Ring
description: A countdown drawn as a ring that empties, with the seconds left in the middle. It counts to a deadline (a timestamp), not from a start, so a page that reloads, or several players in one room, all see the same clock.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/timer-ring

Installed to `components/ui/games/timer-ring.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/timer-ring';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/timer-ring

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
